branchName.instructions: Use `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>`, type one of feat, fix, chore, design, docs; with a GitHub issue `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, e.g. `feat/12-my-work-list`.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits in English: `<type>[(scope)][!]: <summary>`, imperative, lowercase summary, no trailing period, e.g. `feat: show review requests first in My work`. Types feat, fix, perf, refactor, docs, test, build, ci, chore; the only scopes are `web` and `cloud`.

pullRequest.instructions: The title becomes the squash commit on main, so it follows the commit message style (the `title` check enforces it). The body is in English: what changed and why; keep `Closes #<issue>` when the branch has an issue.
